title: EgoLAM: Learning Latent Actions from Hand and Head Motion
abstract: arXiv:2611.27290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent action models let a robot policy learn from video by turning the change between two frames into a training target. In egocentric video, a cup can move across the image because a hand pushes it or because the wearer turns. Both changes help predict the next frame, but only the first describes manipulation. During training, EgoLAM supervises the action code with measured wrist motion and supplies camera motion separately to the forward model. Even when the wearer turns while pushing a cup, the training target still describes how the hand pushed it. The action encoder pools object slots around each hand, and wrist translation and rotation can be decoded from the code in a common reference frame. Extracting a code then requires only two RGB frames. translated_title: EgoLAM：从手部和头部运动中学习潜在动作
translated_abstract: 潜在动作模型通过将两帧之间的变化转化为训练目标，使机器人策略能够从视频中学习。在第一人称（自我中心）视频中，一个杯子在画面中移动，可能是因为有手在推它，也可能是因为佩戴者转动头部。这两种变化都有助于预测下一帧，但只有前者描述了操作行为。在训练过程中，EgoLAM 使用实测的腕部运动来监督动作编码，并将相机运动单独提供给前向模型。即使佩戴者在推杯子的同时转动头部，训练目标仍然描述的是手如何推杯子。动作编码器在每个手部周围汇集物体槽位，腕部的平移和旋转可以在统一参考坐标系中从编码中解码出来。提取一个编码只需要两帧 RGB 图像。除了 LARYBench 的分类和回归任务外，我们还测量了冻结编码保留了多少腕部运动信息，以及它对合成视角或光照变化的响应强度。EgoLAM 具有……
tldr: EgoLAM 通过用第一人称视频中实测的腕部运动监督潜在动作编码的学习，同时将头部运动（相机运动）分离并单独建模，使机器人策略能从自我中心视频中学习真正代表手部操作的潜在动作。
en_tdlr: EgoLAM learns latent action codes from egocentric video by supervising them with measured wrist motion while supplying camera motion separately, enabling robot policies to capture true hand manipulation rather than head movement.
